initial_conclusions: P is the clearest learned geometric primitive candidate.
N has strong downstream precedent but must be tested against normals derived from coherent P before being declared a required learned head.
Exact source mesh faces are not a justified IRIS target; canonical local surface structure should be derived first.
V/support, provenance, graph structure, silhouette/boundary and local differential geometry have strong deterministic-derivation candidates.
U must be separated into predictive risk versus deterministic observability diagnostics; current G1 log_sigma is not yet calibrated U.
Correspondence/persistence is a required capability, but explicit Z is not yet a required external head.
Set-valued H remains a safety candidate for true ambiguity; scalar U is not assumed to encode multimodality.
The verified 1408 observation-to-M5 join is the leading S0-B corpus candidate, subject to byte-level binding and skeleton-truth availability audit.
